touch-target-min.$description: Apple HIG minimum hit target. Visual size may be smaller; hit area never is.

screen-margin.$description: Leading/trailing content margin inside the safe area.

gutter.$description: Between adjacent components: grid columns, controls in a row, chips.

within.$description: Inside a component: icon-to-label gap, chip padding, stacked label + value.

stack-gap.$description: Vertical gap between rows in a list or a form section (compact).

section-gap.$description: Gap between sections on a screen or sheet (compact everywhere, sheets included).

hud-inset.$description: Inset of floating panels (toolbars, HUDs) from the safe-area edge.

hit-halo.$description: Invisible extra hit radius around small on-canvas marks and chips — within a component, so the 4 pt grid applies. The rule it serves: every hit area is ≥ 44 pt.

thumb-zone.$description: Primary actions live in the bottom third of a phone screen (one hand, one thumb).

layout.$description: Compact everywhere: 8 pt between components, 4 pt within. Touch targets stay ≥ 44 pt.

control.$description: Buttons, fields, segmented controls, tool buttons.

chip.$description: Chips, badges, status pills, filter chips: square-shouldered — the smallest radius.

hud.$description: Floating panels and toolbars over a canvas.

sheet.$description: Top corners of bottom sheets — set with .presentationCornerRadius so sheets match the tight scale.

radius.$description: Tight 4 / 8 / 12. Concentric: an inner radius is the outer radius minus the padding.

1.$description: Flat: cards, rows, banners. No shadow — use border.subtle.

2.$description: Floating over the canvas: toolbars, HUD panels, sheets.

elevation.$description: Flat: two layers. Surfaces separate by the neutral ladder and a hairline border; a shadow only lifts what floats over the canvas.

material.$description: Custom Beatham type (not in DTCG): system materials for overlays on a canvas. ios = SwiftUI Material; blur + opacity approximate it in CSS over color.surface.control.

hud.$description: Floating panels and toolbars: near-opaque so they read as flat panels over the canvas.

sheet.$description: Bottom sheets at the medium detent over the canvas.
